subtitle: A book declaring overview and a glossary where no chapter carries anything in
description: A fixture for check-book.sh. One chapter, declaring both `overview` and `glossary`, whose `## In short` section has no carried-in line because there is no chapter before it to carry anything from.

It guards the empty case in the glossary cross-check. bash 3.2 treats `"${arr[@]}"` on an empty array as unbound under `set -u`, so before the guard this book aborted the run with `carried_records[@]: unbound variable` and printed no summary line at all. Every single-chapter book has this shape, as does any book whose chapters all reintroduce nothing.
